subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

Tara has been playing / cricket with her friends / since noon
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is grammatically correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• The usage of the present perfect continuous tense ("has been playing") is appropriate for an action that started in the past and is still ongoing.
 
• The phrase "cricket with her friends" is also correct and conveys the intended meaning.
 
• The preposition "since" is correctly used to indicate the starting point of the action ("since noon").

Therefore, the correct answer is **No error**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Tara has been playing"** – This part is correct as it forms the present perfect continuous tense structure.
 
• **Option 2: "Since noon"** – This part is correct and appropriately indicates the starting point of the action.
 
• **Option 4: "Cricket with her friends"** – This part is grammatically correct and conveys the intended meaning.
